townCentres.name: GeoNames
townCentres.changes: Selected town and neighbourhood centres rounded to 3-6 decimal places. Dublin neighbourhoods use distinct centres; Citywest uses the wider Dublin 24 routing-area centre. District-only or unspecified Dublin reports may use the coarser Dublin centre. Nearby centres cluster dynamically by screen distance; no fake property coordinates or random offsets.
